surface.task: Map the attack surface from repository evidence. List trust boundaries, auth paths, and high-risk modules with citations.

adversarial-review.task: Perform an adversarial review for injection, authz bypass, secret leakage, unsafe subprocess/shell, and over-privileged tools. Cite files.

harden.task: Apply the highest-confidence hardening fixes only where evidence is clear. Prefer small verified patches and registered security checks.
